use default
use System.Math

struct FRAC(numerator: long, denominator: long) is
    +(other: FRAC) -> FRAC =>
        frac(numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator)

    -(other: FRAC) -> FRAC =>
        frac(numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator)

    *(other: FRAC) -> FRAC =>
        frac(numerator * other.numerator, denominator * other.denominator)

    /(other: FRAC) -> FRAC =>
        frac(numerator * other.denominator, denominator * other.numerator)

    ÷(other: FRAC) -> long =>
        let quotient = self / other in
        quotient.numerator / quotient.denominator

    %(other: FRAC) -> FRAC =>
        self - whole(self ÷ other) * other

    <>(other: FRAC) -> int =>
        let left = numerator * other.denominator in
        let right = other.numerator * denominator in
        if left < right then -1 elif left > right then 1 else 0 fi

    to_string() -> string =>
        if denominator == 1L then "{numerator}"
        else "{numerator}/{denominator}"
        fi
si

gcd(a: long, b: long) -> long =>
    if b == 0L then Math.abs(a) else gcd(b, a % b) fi

frac(numerator: long, denominator: long) -> FRAC =>
    let sign = if denominator < 0L then -1L else 1L fi in
    let divisor = gcd(numerator, denominator) * sign in
    FRAC(numerator / divisor, denominator / divisor)

whole(n: long) -> FRAC => FRAC(n, 1L)

-(value: FRAC) -> FRAC => FRAC(-value.numerator, value.denominator)

abs(value: FRAC) -> FRAC =>
    FRAC(Math.abs(value.numerator), value.denominator)

let a = frac(3L, 4L)
let b = frac(-5L, 6L)

write_line("a = {a}, b = {b}")
write_line("a + b = {a + b}, a - b = {a - b}")
write_line("a * b = {a * b}, a / b = {a / b}")
write_line("a ÷ b = {a ÷ b}, a % b = {a % b}")
write_line("-b = {-b}, abs(b) = {abs(b)}")
write_line("a < b: {a < b}, a >= b: {a >= b}")
write_line("a =~ 6/8: {a =~ frac(6L, 8L)}")

let limit = 1 << 19
let sums = LIST[FRAC]((0..limit) |> map(_ => whole(0L)))

for factor in 1..limit do
    let reciprocal = frac(1L, cast(factor))

    let multiple mut = factor

    while multiple < limit do
        sums[multiple] = sums[multiple] + reciprocal
        multiple = multiple + factor
    od
od

let perfect = (1..limit) |> filter(n => sums[n] =~ whole(2L))
write_line("perfect numbers below 2^19: {perfect |> join(", ")}")
